exam_name: Junior Engineer (JE), DMS, CMA & IT - CEN 04/2025
recruitment_summary: The RRB JE 2025-26 cycle (CEN 04/2025) is a massive technical recruitment drive for 2,588 vacancies across 17 Railway Zones. This cycle targets Junior Engineers (JE), Depot Material Superintendents (DMS), and Chemical & Metallurgical Assistants (CMA). As of April 2, 2026, the recruitment has progressed through the CBT-1 stage (held Feb-March 2026), and candidates are currently awaiting the CBT-2 technical schedule. This document provides the complete structural blueprint for the 2025-26 lifecycle.

application_process_workflow: 1. Registration: Navigate to specific RRB website -> 'Apply' -> 'Create an Account'.
2. Credentials: Enter Name, DOB, Father's Name, Aadhaar (Mandatory) and verify via OTP.
3. Zone Selection: Choose the Zonal Railway (Candidates can apply to ONLY one RRB).
4. Post Preferences: Rank the posts based on your medical and educational eligibility.
5. Fee Payment: UR/OBC: ₹500 (₹400 refundable); SC/ST/Female: ₹250 (Full refundable).
6. Final Uploads: Recent color photo (JPEG, 30-70KB) and SC/ST certificate for free travel pass.
